root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: User expects right panel to behave and look identically to left panel; architectural divergence breaks both directions of DnD
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since CandidatesSidebar was introduced; task 20260522-082259 added partial fixes but did not address DnD protocol, full visual parity, or i18n

codex_consult.feedback_summary: 12 findings returned. Key blockers applied: (1) sourceSlotId must NOT be in candidate payloads — semantically wrong for meal-any and causes source-slot clear risk; (2) AC2 strengthened to prove deselect for all 3 card types; (3) visual AC strengthened to require shared style helpers not just image presence; (4) i18n AC scoped to #candidates-groups chrome only to avoid false positives on POI data; (5) loading/empty texts added to i18n scope. Observation: draft correctly avoids carrying user anger into procedural requirements.

findings.issue: Adding sourceSlotId: slotId to candidate payloads is semantically dangerous — meals-any is not a real slot; board onDrop would risk clearing a candidate origin slot
findings.proposed_fix: Candidate payload: { direction: 'candidates', optionId, slotId, originSlotId } — no sourceSlotId. Board onDrop candidates branch gates only on direction === 'candidates', never uses sourceSlotId to clear anything.
findings.rationale: The pre-analysis spec had sourceSlotId in candidate payloads. Removed per codex finding. The board onDrop candidates branch now uses payload.optionId and payload.originSlotId only.

findings.issue: AC2 too weak — 'no regression on handleSidebarDrop' does not prove left→right works for all 3 card types
findings.proposed_fix: AC2 requires verification for meals, accommodation, and activity-slot-backed cards
findings.rationale: AC2 expanded to require all three card types

findings.issue: Visual AC3/AC4 can pass while cards still look different (only image presence checked)
findings.proposed_fix: Replace with requirement to use shared style helpers — image region, category-color header, emoji, RedNoteLink, MapLink, selected shadow, hover behavior, remove standalone candidateCardStyle
findings.rationale: AC3 now requires full board-card layout structure including .slot-drop overlay

findings.issue: i18n scope misses loading/empty texts and other chrome strings beyond listed section labels
findings.proposed_fix: Apply lang logic to loading text (line 2287), empty text (line 2309), all chrome in #candidates-groups
findings.rationale: Added to Bug C fix hints and M7

findings.issue: AC5/AC6 grep-style too broad — could catch POI names or data containing slashes
findings.proposed_fix: Scope acceptance to rendered UI labels inside #candidates-groups only, not arbitrary data fields
findings.rationale: AC5/AC6 now explicitly exempt POI name_local/name_base fields; scoped to chrome labels only

findings.issue: Bug A root-cause claim slightly imprecise — window.setEditorSelection does save, the real risk is origin-slot mutation
findings.proposed_fix: Reword: candidate→board drops must use an explicit path that selects only target slot and never clears origin slot
findings.rationale: Evidence section and M2 reworded accordingly

findings.issue: Scope wording 'all inside CandidatesSidebar' is false — board onDrop handlers are outside it
findings.proposed_fix: Scope wording: touch CandidatesSidebar drag payload/rendering AND board drop handlers that receive those payloads

findings.issue: Accommodation onDrop at line 1320 (no direction gate) should be made consistent, not treated as a standalone divergent case
findings.proposed_fix: Route accommodation through same candidate-vs-board pattern as other 5 handlers
findings.rationale: Technical hints updated — line 1320 now explicitly gets the full 2-branch pattern

findings.issue: Static grep for saveMutations path insufficient for DnD regression — needs browser simulation
findings.proposed_fix: Acceptance should include DOM-level drag simulation proving candidate→board sends target-only mutation
findings.rationale: AC1 verification instruction updated to be more precise about what the grep must confirm

findings.issue: Inline same style tokens verbatim allows future divergence and contradicts same element
findings.proposed_fix: Extract shared card metrics/style/render helpers; allow only container-width adaptation
findings.rationale: Extraction to module scope is listed as preferred (C2 Could Have). Inlining remains acceptable for this cycle to keep scope minimal. User's primary need is visual parity, not enforced sharing mechanism.

findings.issue: Some right→left failures may come from droppable gating or compatibility checks, not only payload shape
findings.proposed_fix: Add scope: candidate drops accepted on every editable compatible target slot; rejects only for skipped/late-arrival/incompatible
findings.rationale: Existing _isCompatible and droppable gating are protected guards. The AC1 verification instruction covers this implicitly.

findings.issue: Draft correctly avoids carrying user anger into procedural requirements

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: 6 major findings applied: removed sourceSlotId from candidate payloads, strengthened AC2 for 3 card types, strengthened AC3/AC4 for full board-card layout structure, added loading/empty texts to i18n scope, scoped AC5/AC6 to #candidates-groups chrome only, updated line 1320 to get full 2-branch pattern.
